positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend/full-stack engineer delivering scalable, cloud-native solutions with Python, TypeScript, React, and AWS. Partnered with product managers, UX, and domain experts to modernize clinical platforms and deliver measurable business outcomes.

•	Performance optimization: Built the eAuthoring Document Formatting API;  Later introduced async header/subheader chunking for LLM integration, reducing response times by ~50% during development.
•	Iterative development: Took eAuthoring Formatter from concept → stakeholder pitch → MVP → demos → full adoption, practicing rapid shipping, unit/regression testing, and feedback-driven iteration.
•	Cloud-native delivery: Designed and deployed serverless APIs (AWS Lambda, S3, Fargate) powering document workflows handling thousands of daily requests.
•	Cross-team collaboration: Worked across product, design, UX, and data science teams, ensuring business and technical alignment; consistently communicated value to stakeholders.
•	CI/CD leadership: Contributed to improving CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), reducing deployment effort and increasing release reliability.

Highlighted Projects:
•	Lilly eAuthoring: Built the plaintext- to DOCX Formatter API from scratch; praised for performance and scalability. Later extended with AI prompt-engineering to increase accuracy. Confluence pages of API and testing documentation adopted across development and QA teams.
•	Lilly Nexus Platform: Delivered backend/frontend features with Auth0-based authentication and Postgres-backed RBAC; built reusable UI/UX components; integrated Google Analytics with reusable classes; led weekly troubleshooting improving team productivity.
•	RSI Global Patient Safety Platform: Built backend and frontend features to migrate legacy SharePoint workflows into modern full-stack services; delivered all milestones on time and recognized for execution

positions.title: Software Engineer (DoD Skillbridge Participant)
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a new analytics feature that replaced manual Excel workflows; integrated Chart.js into the platform to generate real-time visualizations directly from scientists’ lab data.
•	Optimized libraries and upgraded dependencies to improve performance and maintainability.
•	Presented feature enhancements directly to senior stakeholders.

positions.title: Digital Wideband Systems Technician
positions.description:
As a Digital Wideband Repair Technician, I maintained and repaired secure communication systems critical to Marine Corps operations. I specialized in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and restoring distributed communication networks to ensure mission readiness.

Key Achievements:

•	Supervised and trained Marines in the operation and maintenance of digital wideband and nodal transmission systems.

•	Diagnosed and repaired advanced transmission systems under high-pressure conditions, sustaining reliable comms support for deployed units.

•	Delivered technical expertise and cross-team collaboration to resolve complex system issues and maintain operational continuity.

positions.title: Calibration Program Manager
positions.description:
Led 9th Communication Battalion calibration program, overseeing the planning, coordination, and execution of all calibration activities for thousands of mission-critical assets valued in the millions. Ensured equipment accuracy, reliability, and compliance with Marine Corps standards.

Key Achievements:

•	 Directed data processing, information systems, systems analysis, and reporting to maintain program effectiveness.

•	Implemented quality control procedures to guarantee proper calibration of sensitive communications and technical equipment.

•	Coordinated with cross-functional teams to sustain operational readiness and mission success.

•	Streamlined processes and improved accountability across a program supporting thousands of items worth millions of dollars.

positions.title: Database Architect Consultant
positions.description:
•	Provided cloud and data architecture consulting under Devpro LLC for Heart2Help, a caregiving service, to establish HIPAA compliant data storage and integration patterns.
•	Designed strategies for HIPAA compliant databases, cloud data systems, and enterprise API integrations, including standards for database operations, query practices, and security controls.
•	Proposed solutions to create and optimize Azure based network storage for a hybrid environment, covering cloud infrastructure, on site workflows, and patterns for secure data exchange between systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Architecture · Azure Active Directory · Python (Programming Language) · Node.js · Software Systems Engineering · API Development · Microsoft Azure
